raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Description

`InfBridge.agenerate` reads the current weight version after awaiting the backend response. If `set_version()` runs while that request is in flight, its tokens are labelled with the updated version instead of the version at dispatch.

Capture the version before each HTTP request and use it for that segment's `output_versions`. An aborted request keeps its original version, while its resubmission captures the updated version. This applies the same approach already used by `RemoteInfEngine` in #1569 to the v2 bridge.

The regression covers both SGLang and vLLM, with and without abort/resubmit. On the original code, the interrupted case reports `[11, 11, 12]` instead of `[10, 10, 11]`; it passes with this change.

## Related Issue

Related: #1569 (the corresponding v1 fix). No existing issue found for the v2 path.

## Type of Change

- [x] 🐛 Bug fix
- [ ] ✨ New feature
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] ♻️ Refactoring
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] ✅ Test coverage improvement

## Checklist

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/areal-project/community/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] Pre-commit hooks pass (`pre-commit run --all-files`)
- [x] Relevant tests pass; new tests added for new functionality
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable; built with `./docs/build_all.sh`)
- [x] Branch is up to date with `main`
- [ ] Self-reviewed via `/review-pr` command
- [x] This PR was created by a coding agent via `/create-pr`
- [ ] This PR is a breaking change

## Additional Context

Validation on Python 3.12, PyTorch 2.10.0+cpu, and Transformers 5.3.0:

```text
python -m pytest tests/v2/inference_service/test_inf_bridge.py \
  tests/test_rollout_version_race.py \
  tests/v2/inference_service/test_data_proxy_version.py \
  tests/v2/inference_service/test_data_proxy_pause.py -q
50 passed
```

The four new cases fail on the original code and pass with the fix. Eight additional controlled local HTTP scenarios exercised both backends, initial pause, and abort/resubmit with real socket transport. These use test responses; GPU inference and RL training were not run for this client-side metadata change.

AI assistance was used to prepare the patch and regression tests. The checks above were executed by the coding agent.

                 remaining,

+            # A weight update may complete before this segment's response arrives.
+            request_version = self._version
             data = await self._send_request(http_req)
             result = self.backend.parse_generation_response(data)
 
             accumulated_tokens.extend(result.output_tokens)

-            accumulated_versions.extend([self._version] * len(result.output_tokens))
+            accumulated_versions.extend([request_version] * len(result.output_tokens))
             stop_reason = cast(_StopReason, result.stop_reason)
 
             if result.routed_experts is not None:

@@ -342,6 +342,39 @@ async def test_output_versions_tracks_version_changes(self):
 
         assert resp.output_versions == [7]
 
+    @pytest.mark.asyncio
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("backend_name", ["sglang", "vllm"])
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("interrupted", [False, True])
+    async def test_output_versions_pinned_before_request(
+        self, backend_name, interrupted
+    ):
+        """Each segment retains its dispatch version across an in-flight update."""
+        backend = (
+            SGLangBridgeBackend() if backend_name == "sglang" else VLLMBridgeBackend()
+        )
+        bridge = _make_bridge(version=10, backend=backend)
+        responses = [([100, 101], [-0.5, -0.3], "abort" if interrupted else "stop")]
+        if interrupted:
+            responses.append(([102], [-0.2], "stop"))
+
+        async def send_request(http_req):
+            tokens, logprobs, reason = responses.pop(0)
+            # A weight update completes while the HTTP response is in flight.
+            await asyncio.sleep(0)
+            bridge.set_version(bridge.get_version() + 1)
+            if backend_name == "sglang":
+                return _make_sglang_response(list(zip(logprobs, tokens)), reason)
+            return _make_vllm_response(tokens, logprobs, reason)
+
+        bridge._send_request = AsyncMock(side_effect=send_request)
+        try:
+            resp = await bridge.agenerate(_make_request())
+        finally:
+            await bridge.aclose()
+
+        assert resp.output_tokens == ([100, 101, 102] if interrupted else [100, 101])
+        assert resp.output_versions == ([10, 10, 11] if interrupted else [10, 10])
+
     # -- 10. n_samples validation ------------------------------------------------
 
     @pytest.mark.asyncio
